constraint: external connectors require official provider documentation, source-owner authorization, stable event identifiers and sandbox evidence before activation
production deployment, money movement, secret creation, irreversible migrations and locked Intent_DNA edits remain outside autonomous execution
project-specific business, tax, contract and retention rules must be marked as assumptions until an accountable owner confirms them
analysis results must link to source evidence and state their period, scope and uncertainty
evolution: Pass 1 gather actual implementation outcomes, failed assumptions and test evidence from repeated managed-app projects
Pass 2 improve provider-neutral templates and validated architecture recipes
Pass 3 propose stable, privacy-reviewed lessons for ETERNIAN review before Intent_DNA lock
invariant: one repeatable path from plain-language need through requirements, data model, code, tests and operator manual
tenant/account authorization is enforced in every screen, query, analysis and export
replayed source events are idempotent and financial corrections preserve the original event
open decisions and assumptions remain visible in the handoff
independent draft development does not bypass approval or deployment gates
journey: read repo instructions → map people, workflows, data and risks → validate intake → design canonical model and connectors → implement vertical slice → test security and calculations → package deployment and manual → submit evidence-linked PR
provider details missing → prepare vendor intake and adapter contract → keep connector disabled → activate only after sandbox and owner approval
outcome: ARKAON can plan and independently implement a bounded management-program feature from an approved request
a non-specialist operator can start, reconcile, close, recover and understand the delivered system
provider-specific code is testable and replaceable without changing canonical business records
each delivery carries tests, deployment steps, backups, data boundaries and unresolved questions
owner: ARKAON project implementer under an authorized request
business owner accountable for contracts, rates, tax rules and data permission
ETERNIAN reviewer for knowledge promotion and Intent_DNA lock
risk: an unstated business rule silently produces an incorrect financial result
cross-tenant analytics or exports expose private business records
provider status, signatures, retries or payout semantics are assumed incorrectly
passing unit tests are mistaken for production authorization or vendor certification
over-generalized learning retains credentials, customer data or private contract terms
signal: intake validation errors and unresolved assumption count
cross-tenant denial tests and replay duplicate rate
provider sandbox conformance and reconciliation mismatch aging
manual usability findings and restore-test result
rework caused by missing requirements or unsupported assumptions
value: shorten delivery time for future inventory, booking, membership, settlement and administrative systems using tested patterns
raise completeness and operator usability without weakening privacy, financial integrity or review gates
turn each authorized implementation into reusable, evidence-backed engineering knowledge
who: business requester and accountable system owner
why: The addon-polo tenant sales project demonstrates a reusable pattern for building an operational management system from discovery through CSV-first ingestion, settlement analysis, tests, Docker and a non-specialist manual.
